statement: This sketch creates an immersive underground environment where complex organic structures slowly emerge from a derelict industrial space. The scene combines slime mould-like growth patterns with rusted pipe frameworks that suggest a forgotten boiler room. Structures bloom and shift through time, revealing new layers of detail in muted browns, oxidized reds, and crystalline whites. The viewer experiences an endless unfolding of matter—both natural and architectural—growing and revealing itself in the dark, creating a sense of slow, relentless life beneath the surface.
